steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Editing is the process of selecting, arranging and combining shots to construct narrative, meaning and emotional impact. | Key Fact: Continuity editing creates a seamless, invisible flow that maintains spatial and temporal coherence for the viewer. | Key Fact: The 180-degree rule ensures the camera stays on one side of an imaginary line between characters to preserve screen direction and spatial consistency. | Key Fact: Shot-reverse-shot alternates between two characters in conversation, creating the impression of a natural conversational exchange.
